lines.trans: Hi, Kostya!
I confessed everything to Katya after all.
Really? You made a big mistake doing that.
Nastya is still not speaking to me.
I even slept on the floor today.
Are you saying that seriously?
Here is what I thought last night.
I will come home and give her a massage.
She did not let me give her a massage.
In short, listen to my new advice.
You must never tell them anything at all.
Do not tell under any circumstances!
